> A MIDI macropad with 6 mechanical switches, per-key RGB, a rotary encoder and 7 capacitive touch keys. It is powered using a 2000mah battery and a TP4056 module. It is controlled by a Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero. It can turn on and off using a rocker switch.
